labels.type:bug: Existing behavior is incorrect or broken.
labels.type:feature: Adds a capability that does not exist yet.
labels.type:maintenance: Internal upkeep, refactoring, dependencies or qualification.
labels.type:investigation: Resolves a question, evaluates an approach or establishes a design.
labels.type:tracking: Coordinates a larger outcome through child issues.

labels.area:build: Discovery, planning, build graphs, orchestration and artifact assembly.
labels.area:cache: Cache keys, invalidation, result and compiler-state reuse.
labels.area:execution: Processes, isolation, environments, cancellation and resource handling.
labels.area:plugins: Protocol, SDK, hosting, discovery, compatibility and installation.
labels.area:tools: Toolchain resolution, acquisition, installation and activation.
labels.area:tasks: Task discovery, definitions, dependencies and invocation.
labels.area:testing: Product test selection, sharding, flaky-test handling and reports.
labels.area:publisher: Publishing built user artifacts to GitHub, OCI, npm or PyPI.
labels.area:versioning: Version inference, Git history, tags and release intent.
labels.area:release: Shipping Oyzu and plugins, distribution, channels and self-update.
labels.area:remote: Remote runs, execution integration and replay.
labels.area:trust: Signing, verification, identity of artifacts, credentials and enforcement boundaries.
labels.area:compliance: Licenses, notices, disclosure and distribution obligations.
labels.area:identity: Sign-in, SSO, sessions and enterprise identity provisioning.
labels.area:access: Roles, permissions, memberships, authorization and delegation.
labels.area:projects: Projects, repositories and their configuration and relationships.
labels.area:policy: Inherited controls, constraints, approvals and governance.
labels.area:secrets: Secret storage, rotation and credential delivery.
labels.area:runs: Run submission, jobs, lifecycle, results and retries.
labels.area:fleet: Worker pools, placement, capacity and worker readiness.
labels.area:registry: Artifact registration, metadata, discovery and retention.
labels.area:delivery: Artifact downloads, distribution proxies and delivery authorization.
labels.area:metrics: Product analytics: build/cache trends, usage, consumption and aggregate reporting.
labels.area:audit: Attributable activity, change history and durable audit records.
labels.area:observability: Service instrumentation, health monitoring, logs, traces and alerting.
labels.area:integrations: Webhooks, GitHub and other external providers and connectors.
labels.area:infrastructure: Hosting, networking, databases, backups and operational recovery.
labels.area:design-system: Shared UI components, interaction patterns and accessibility.

labels.flag:performance: Performance or resource efficiency is central.
labels.flag:security: A security concern supported by the issue.
